meta.note: Curated routing tips (hand-written, not generated). Shown in the Character view and the Roadmap.
meta.author: reiassezbeau — https://github.com/reiassezbeau

tips.title: Mother + The Beast: get the most out of your ending runs
tips.text: Take the alternate path (the Mausoleum/Gehenna door after Mom's Heart, usually behind a statue challenge). Go down to the Corpse to beat Mother, which fills the Mother mark. For The Beast, take the Home trapdoor after picking up the key piece. Do it on Hard mode to earn the GOLD mark, which is what Dead God requires.

tips.title: Always on Hard for Dead God
tips.text: A mark earned on Normal counts as completed but stays SILVER. Dead God requires the GOLD mark (Hard) on all 12 marks for all 34 characters. Redo on Hard any mark that is still Normal.

tips.title: Boss Rush: get there before 20:00
tips.text: Boss Rush opens by beating Mom before the 20-minute mark, in Mom's room (the hole-riddled door). Handy for unlocking several items and filling the Boss Rush mark.

tips.title: Hush: reach the Womb before 30:00
tips.text: The gaping trapdoor to ???/Blue Womb appears if you beat Mom's Heart / It Lives! before 30:00. It leads to Hush.

tips.title: Ultra Greed / Greedier
tips.text: The "Greed" mark is filled in Greed Mode (Ultra Greed); the Hard/gold variant requires Greedier Mode. It is a separate mode, and an easy one to forget on the way to Dead God.

tips.title: Delirium: through The Void
tips.text: Delirium lives in The Void, reachable through a portal after beating Hush (Blue Womb). It is a long, random fight: show up with solid damage.

tips.title: Characters that lag behind: Bethany and Jacob & Esau
tips.text: These two Repentance characters have almost no marks. Chain dedicated runs: Mom's Heart, then Isaac / Satan / ??? / Lamb (the base paths), then Mother and Beast on Hard. A big jump in progress toward Dead God.
